verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a terminal app, and its local command set could plausibly include git, so the axis applies. The evidence lists local commands (cat, grep, cp, curl, scp, sftp) and SSH/Mosh access, but never mentions git or submodule support. Running git on a remote host over SSH is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can clone, update, and manage Git submodules within a repository
